from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):

        self.play(Create(line_u), FadeIn(label_u))
        self.play(Create(line_y), FadeIn(label_y))

        dot_u1 = Dot(seg_u_start, color=color_g, radius=0.08)
        dot_u2 = Dot(seg_u_end, color=color_g, radius=0.08)

        arrow_g2 = CurvedArrow(seg_x_end, seg_u_end, angle=-TAU/8, color=color_g)
        
        label_g = MathTex(r"\frac{du}{dx} = 2", color=color_g, font_size=34)
        self.place_at_grid(label_g, "C2", scale_factor=0.8)

        self.play(Create(seg_x), FadeIn(dot_x1), FadeIn(dot_x2))
        self.play(Create(arrow_g1), Create(arrow_g2))
        self.play(Create(seg_u), FadeIn(dot_u1), FadeIn(dot_u2), Write(label_g))
        self.wait(1.5)

        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(color_f))

        seg_y_start = self.grid["F2"] + 0.5 * RIGHT

        seg_y = Line(seg_y_start, seg_y_end, color=color_f, stroke_width=8)
        dot_y1 = Dot(seg_y_start, color=color_f, radius=0.08)
        dot_y2 = Dot(seg_y_end, color=color_f, radius=0.08)
        
        arrow_f1 = CurvedArrow(seg_u_start, seg_y_start, angle=-TAU/8, color=color_f)
        arrow_f2 = CurvedArrow(seg_u_end, seg_y_end, angle=-TAU/8, color=color_f)
        
        label_f = MathTex(r"\frac{dy}{du} = 3", color=color_f, font_size=34)
        self.place_at_grid(label_f, "E2", scale_factor=0.8)

        self.play(Create(arrow_f1), Create(arrow_f2))
        self.play(Create(seg_y), FadeIn(dot_y1), FadeIn(dot_y2), Write(label_f))
        self.wait(1.5)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # Summarize the total scaling factor (Product of derivatives)
        self.play(self.lecture[3].animate.set_color(color_total))
        
        # Highlighting the compound mapping from X directly to Y
        arrow_total = Arrow(self.grid["B5"], self.grid["F5"], color=color_total, buff=0.1)
        label_total = MathTex(r"Total\ Scale = 2 \times 3 = 6", color=color_total, font_size=36)
        # Position label in a clear area to the right
        self.place_in_area(label_total, "D4", "F6", scale_factor=0.8)

        self.play(Create(arrow_total))
        self.play(Write(label_total))
        self.wait(2.0)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # Final emphasis on the multiplicative nature of the chain rule
        self.play(self.lecture[4].animate.set_color(WHITE))
        self.play(Indicate(label_total, color=color_total))
        self.wait(2.0)
